supersedes.headline: GATES CONFORMING TO §3.9 ON THE LIVE PATH: 6/15
supersedes.why: The /1 audit was scored against V1 clause lists and V1 line anchors (lines 4335-4348 and 4352), and it counted module presence as conformance. Against V1.1 and the evidence rules of §0.5 no gate conforms: Gate 1 lacks the keyed seal, widget_id and the L8 outcomes with the R3.9.4 successor; Gate 3 compares a local sha256, not c9PrincipalHash; Gate 4 does not call assertTenantId; Gate 5 lacks SUPERSEDED, the successor, the counter and the in-transaction level; Gate 2 is a constant pass in slot 2 with G2-EQ not run; Gate 14 is a terminate pointer that no widget submission passes (AREA-C F-1; review findings 1 and 2). This re-baseline lowers the headline from 6 to 0 and flips nothing up.

why: Each V1.1 row is split into the clause keys of the plan's §3.1 inventory (the keys of gate-clause-inventory.json, added by I-HAR). A clause counts only when its state is L or L-T (strict) or also U (with U-class), with evidence entries, mutant artifact ids and ruling pins. `built: true` records that code for the clause exists at the base commit; it never counts. GATE MODULE EXISTS ≠ GATE ENFORCED.

clauseStates.L: executed on the live admission path with real input: HTTP (AppModule, all six APP_GUARDs, FeatureGuard not overridden, widgets.runtime granted by Fixtures.grantFeature) AND BIN (dist/src/main), on a record minted by P-MINT-CORE from a production trigger (T-2b, T-2a, T-1, T-3, or a qualifying successor edge), provenance verified per D-17; counts strict and U
clauseStates.L (EP-BUILD clause): a clause whose certified evaluation point is EP-BUILD: its EP-BUILD test green in the flipping commit's CI and, where it protects a runtime property, an L test on the same commit; counts strict and U
clauseStates.L-T: a defence-in-depth refusal evidenced by E-TAMPER (never on a SealVerifier column except G1-a) or E-INDEP on the live path, only with an L positive for the same clause and every declared mutant live-killed by an [HTTP] killer; never for Gate 9/10 clauses; counts strict and U
clauseStates.U: no conformant input this cycle by certified text or settled scope, with all four proof duties of §0.5 and the quoted basis; counts toward the U count only (OD-3)
clauseStates.STOPPED:<id>: held by a Sheet 06 STOP (§0.4); counts toward neither
clauseStates.BLOCKED-DISCHARGE: needs an actuating mint (D-4); counts toward neither until E2
clauseStates.false: anything else, including G-SYNTH, RI, stub owners, GW-only runs, unit tests, hand fixtures, a green mutation run alone, k3 presence or liveGateCount; counts toward neither

clauseFields.conforms: true only when state is L or L-T (the strict count); false for every clause at I-AUD0
clauseFields.built: code for the clause exists at baseCommit (annotation only; never evidence)
clauseFields.built_note: what is present and what is missing
clauseFields.u_candidate: true when OD-3 lists the clause (or a named part, see u_candidate_scope) as a U candidate; recorded false until the four U duties are met
clauseFields.u_basis: the certified or settled sentence the U claim would quote
clauseFields.reason: "not built (DEV-1; OD-1)" on every DEV-1 clause
clauseFields.blocked: why a BLOCKED-DISCHARGE clause is blocked
clauseFields.blocked_part: a sub-case of a non-blocked key that is BLOCKED-DISCHARGE until E2
clauseFields.false_part: a sub-case that stays false on a delivery dependency
clauseFields.after_discharge: what the state becomes after E2 without the named registration
clauseFields.waits_on: delivery dependencies or owner decisions (a slip keeps the clause false; it never moves it to U)
clauseFields.evidence: evidence-manifest lines (test id, entry HTTP/BIN, trigger trace, record hash, labels); empty at I-AUD0
clauseFields.mutants: mutant ids with the widgets-mutation artifact id and status; empty at I-AUD0
clauseFields.rulings: ruling pins (DS-03 A, A3 rows, B-nn, AMB-nn, D-n)
